segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the package for the renewal and the expansion. I have you at 38 current seats and adding 12, so 50 total starting March 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. The only thing is we may not activate all 12 on day one. Finance approved the 50, but operations will probably roll in six people first and the rest by April.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that's fine. The contract would show 50 licensed seats, and your admin can assign them as needed. No extra implementation charge for staging those users.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the price you sent was $48 per seat per month, billed annually, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. So the annual subscription is $28,800, plus the $3,200 onboarding for the workflow updates we scoped. Total first-year order is $32,000 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Can you make the invoice split between subscription and onboarding? Our AP team needs the services line separate.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I can set that up in the billing tool. It'll be one invoice with two line items, net 30 terms, and I can include the PO number if you have it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: PO is 4176-BC. We need the invoice dated after February 15, though. Our new budget doesn't open until then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. I'll queue the order for signature this week, and billing will issue the invoice on February 16. Target go-live for the updated workflows is still March 18?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, March 18 is good. If you can send the order form today, I'll get legal to do a quick pass. They already approved the same terms last year, so I don't expect much.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. I'll send it over by 3 p.m. with the 12-month term, March 1 through February 28, 50 seats, annual billing, and the PO on the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Once it's signed, loop in Marcus from my team for the onboarding schedule. He'll own the admin setup.
